basic_details.job_title: NIT Goa Junior Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Goa has invited applications for one Junior Assistant (Purchase) post on a temporary basis (Advt. No. NITGOA/RECT/CONT/2026/59, dated 04-11-2026). The consolidated pay is Rs. 29,300 per month for an initial period of 6 months, which may be extended for another 6 months based on satisfactory performance. The essential qualification is Senior Secondary (10+2) from a recognized board with a minimum typing speed of 35 w.p.m and proficiency in computer word processing and spread sheet. Applications go through a Google Form, and the last date is 19-11-2026.

how_to_apply: Fill the required data in the application form format attached to the notice.
Compile the duly filled application form, the scanned copy of original documents and the relevant experience documents (if any) into a single *.pdf file.
Open the Google Form link given in the notice for the Junior Assistant (Purchase) on Temporary Basis post.
Attach the *.pdf file in the space provided in the Google Form.
Submit the application through the Google Form by 19-11-2026.
The application form in the notice asks for the following:
Name in block letters, date of birth, age, gender, marital status, nationality and category
Contact and permanent address, and contact details including mobile and e-mail ID
Academic record starting with the school-leaving exam, with photocopies of transcripts, mark sheets, grade cards and certificates for all degrees
Achievements (state and national level, with supporting documents) and extracurricular activities including NCC
Present employment and experience, with job profile (a separate sheet may be attached if required)
Names and contact details of three referees, any other relevant information, the list of documents attached, and the signed declaration with date and place
Incomplete application forms shall not be considered for shortlisting. For any information, email [email protected] or write to Recruitment Cell, NIT Goa, Cuncolim, South Goa District, Goa - 403703.
important_instructions: The number of posts advertised is merely an indication of the existing vacancies. The Institute reserves all rights to fill or not fill, or to increase or decrease, any number of posts. No candidate will have any claim to an appointment letter as a matter of right, even after recommendation by the Selection (Interview) Committee. Mention a correct and active email ID in the application, because all correspondence will be through email only. Regular checking of the email is expected. Any other applicable rule will be followed, although not mentioned in the notice.
